summary: In Greek mythology, Actor son of Hippasus is the Achaean Argonaut from Pellene listed by Apollodorus and Hyginus among Jason's comrades. He is one of many mythic Actors and must not be merged with Actor father of the Moliones, Actor father of Menoetius, or Actor son of Azeus.
etymology: Ancient Greek Ἄκτωρ from ἄγω, "to lead"; a very common mythic name.

sections.heading: Argonaut son of Hippasus
paragraphs: Apollodorus and Hyginus name Actor son of Hippasus among the Argonauts; Hyginus places him in the Peloponnese, and the Wikipedia roll specifies Pellene. The catalogue entry is brief — a named shipmate rather than an adventure cycle of his own.

The Hippasus–Pellene link in Hyginus also attaches to Asterion and Amphion as sons of Hyperasius (or alternatively of Hippasus); those Hyperasids are separate atlas nodes (asterion-pellene, amphion-pella).

sections.heading: Homonym care
paragraphs: The atlas id actor-argonaut is the Hippasid Argonaut alone. Distinct from actor-epeian (Elean father of the Moliones), actor-azeus (Minyan father of Astyoche), and the many other Actors listed on the Wikipedia disambiguation.
